subject: Security notification + IRP request for Q3 audit window
messages:
From: Chris Nolan <chris@acmepay.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: secops@acmepay.com
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:12:00 -0700
Subject: Observed auth anomaly — request for IRP summary and scoped logs

Hi Sofia,

We observed an elevated authentication rate for our tenant between 2026-10-13T23:40Z and 2026-10-14T00:05Z. At this time we have no confirmed customer-impacting credential misuse, but our SOC team is opening a ticket as part of our Q3 audit window.

Two asks from our side to help us close this quickly with our auditor:
- A short incident timeline (redacted) showing detection and containment steps that Redwood took for this window.
- A short excerpt of your Incident Response Plan (IRP) section that covers detection + notification SLAs and evidence retention for tenant-scoped auth anomalies.

If possible, can you provide those artifacts by EOD 2026-10-14? Our auditor (cc'd) needs them for preliminary triage. If you prefer, we can sign a brief NDA/DocuSign for expanded access to sample logs.

Thanks for the quick help — we appreciate it.

--
Chris Nolan
Head of InfoSec
AcmePay
chris@acmepay.com
From: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nolan <chris@acmepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 09:25:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed auth anomaly — request for IRP summary and scoped logs

Chris — thanks for the heads up and the clear asks.

We will prioritize this. I'm looping in Marissa (security compliance lead) and Karthik (IR ops) to assemble a redacted timeline and the IRP excerpt.

Quick notes:
- We'll provide a redacted timeline and the IRP excerpt by EOD PT 2026-10-14. If the auditor needs raw logs, we can exchange via DocuSign/NDA and a secure transfer (S3 pre-signed + envelope).
- Can you confirm the exact tenant id and the sample request window you want logs for (we'll align the export window to avoid extra work)?

Respecting the audit window — we'll aim to keep artifacts scoped and redacted.

Sofia
Senior Customer Security Liaison
Redwood Inference
sofia_ivanova@redwood.com
From: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>
To: sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>, Chris Nolan <chris@acmepay.com>
Cc: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 11:30:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed auth anomaly — request for IRP summary and scoped logs

Chris / Sofia —

We investigated the auth spike you reported and have compiled a short redacted timeline and a short IRP excerpt that covers detection, triage, and notification steps. Attached: redacted-timeline-acm-10-14.pdf and IRP-excerpt-redwood-2026.pdf (stubs attached to this thread).

Summary (high level):
- 2026-10-13T23:43Z — anomaly flagged by internal rate-based detector (automation rule R-Auth-4).
- 2026-10-13T23:45Z — automated sampling started; initial sample shows elevated failed/success ratio; no anomalous pattern of token exfiltration observed in KV cache or artifact uploads.
- 2026-10-13T23:58Z — temporary tightening of auth throttles for affected tenant; no revert actions required.
- 2026-10-14T00:05Z — alert resolved; monitoring remained stable.

Artifacts we are prepared to share (scoped):
- Redacted timeline PDF (contains sanitized event labels and timestamps).
- Sample auth events (anonymized) with IPs redacted; we can provide via secure transfer after an NDA if needed.
- IRP excerpt describing detection thresholds, roles, and retention windows.

Two clarifying questions for the auditor:
1) What minimum retention format do you require (CSV vs. parquet)?
2) Do you require raw IPs / full headers (we can redaction-step those if needed but will need an NDA).

I'll follow up with a secure-link plan once we get confirmation.

--
Marissa Cole
Security & Compliance Manager
Redwood Inference
marissa_cole@redwood.com
From: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>
To: Chris Nolan <chris@acmepay.com>, marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, sofia_ivanova <sofia_ivanova@redwood.com>
Cc: laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Wed, 14 Oct 2026 17:05:00 -07:00
Subject: Re: Observed auth anomaly — request for IRP summary and scoped logs

Chris — following Marissa's summary, we're preparing the scoped export. Per your earlier note about the auditor, we can:

- Provide sample logs in CSV with token and IP redaction (default).
- If Veritas (cc'd) requires full headers, please send the signed DocuSign NDA link; we'll provision a time-limited, encrypted S3 bundle for pickup and provide an MD5 checksum and transfer manifest.

For internal traceability I've attached a short sample manifest stub (auth-events-sample-logs-20261014.zip (stub)). We'll hold off on sharing raw headers until we have the signed DocuSign:3fa4b1c9-IRP-NDA record referenced earlier.

Next step from Redwood: once we receive confirmation from your side on retention format and the NDA decision, we will:
1) Post the redacted timeline to the shared Drive link.
2) Stage the sample logs in a secured bucket with access expiry of 72 hours.
3) Provide an audit-friendly manifest noting redaction steps.

Karthik
IR Operations
Redwood Inference
karthik_iyer@redwood.com
From: Audits Team <audits@veritas-audit.com>
To: karthik_iyer <karthik_iyer@redwood.com>, Chris Nolan <chris@acmepay.com>
Cc: marissa_cole <marissa_cole@redwood.com>, laura_bennett <laura_bennett@redwood.com>
Date: Thu, 15 Oct 2026 15:42:00 -07:00
Subject: RE: Observed auth anomaly — request for IRP summary and scoped logs

Thanks all — we have what we need for the initial triage. The redacted timeline and IRP excerpt are sufficient to satisfy the first auditor check.

Two quick items:
- AcmePay's audit team will sign the short NDA via DocuSign. Chris, please confirm and push the link and we'll accept the S3 bundle once available.
- If we require deeper traces for evidence, we will request them in a separate, scoped request (we currently do not need IP-level data).

Appreciate the quick turnaround — please leave the Drive share open for 48 hours so our reviewer can pull the files.

Regards,
Alex (on behalf of Veritas Audits)
Veritas Audit Services
audits@veritas-audit.com
